title: Grilled Snappy Apricot Skewers with Peruvian Sauce
description: A Japanese-inspired sweet and savory dish featuring grilled apricot skewers served with a Peruvian-style sauce.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the apricots onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Peruvian, lively, and apricot jam.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the apricot skewers.
Grill the skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until lightly charred.
In a small saucepan, heat the suspiro over low heat.
Add the lime juice and stir to combine.
Season with salt and sugar to taste.
Serve the grilled apricot skewers with the Peruvian sauce.
Garnish with additional lively, if desired.
